title: Conformity and Social Impact on AI Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal LLMs on objective visual discrimination tasks (e.g., line judgment, color recognition, dots estimation) while introducing social pressure by prepending prompts with a series of deliberately incorrect answers from simulated prior participants.

Assigning the model a specific identity (nationality, ethnicity, or an arbitrary minimal group) and comparing its conformity levels when the simulated prior responses originate from in-group members versus out-group members.

Modifying the descriptions of the simulated prior participants to represent varying levels of perceived authority and expertise (e.g., scientists, judges, policemen, kids, or chatbots) to measure how source strength modulates conformity.
